practice_phrases.known: Every day, I learn something new.
I like to learn languages at home.
When I have time, I learn by reading books.
practice_phrases.target: 我有时间的时候，我通过读书学习。

practice_phrases.known: I think it's important to learn from our mistakes.
practice_phrases.target: 我认为从错误中学习很重要。

practice_phrases.known: After work, I learn Chinese by watching videos and practicing.
practice_phrases.target: 下班后，我通过看视频和练习学习中文。

practice_phrases.known: I want to learn how to cook traditional Chinese food this year.
practice_phrases.target: 今年我想学习如何做传统中国菜。
